name: WindowsWitcher
author: Wartafak
description: Show and navigate open windows with a top-bar icon strip (one icon per window grouped by workspace, active highlight, left-click to focus, middle/right-click to close, workspace tooltip, auto-hides when empty, special workspaces excluded) plus a Super+Tab switcher (tap to toggle last two windows, hold Super+Tab/Shift+Tab or Up/Down to cycle in most-recently-used order, release Super to confirm, click to focus, Esc to dismiss).

barWidget.description: Open-window icons in the top bar + Super+Tab switcher
